pairs.question: quare id faceret aut quid Aristides commisisset, cur tanta poena dignus duceretur?
pairs.answer: Se ignorare Aristiden, sed sibi non placere, quod tam cupide elaborasset, ut praeter ceteros Iustus appellaretur.
pairs.derivation: Reported exchange between Aristides and an illiterate citizen writing to ostracize him. Dropped the question framing 'quaesisse ab eo dicitur' and the answer framing 'Cui ille respondit'; both spans are the author's own words in oratio obliqua. Question is the genuine interrogative (quare/quid/cur). Answer begins at the operative response 'Se ignorare...' and runs to the end of the response clause; nothing is cut after, the sentence ends there before the new sentence 'Hic X annorum...'.
